This stable release rolls up dev pre-release **v2.25-dev** since the previous stable (v2.24). It adds a dedicated About page.

## New: About page

Training Tracker now has a dedicated **About** page.

- Reach it from the new **About** link in the sidebar footer (between Night Mode
  and Sign out).
- It shows the application title and a short description of what Training Tracker
  does, the **current version** you're running, the developer credit, and quick
  links to the **release notes** and the **GitHub repository** (both open in a
  new tab).

## Notes

- UI-only change — no database migration.

No action needed after updating.
